paragraph: The Granville composite reads right down the middle at a balanced 50 out of 100 with zero breadth divergence warnings, pointing to an equilibrium state at the open. Internal mechanics are largely range-bound as bellwether semiconductors edge up 0.24% and transports flash a bullish +0.38% relative to the S&P, though a sharp 1.59% drop in high-beta versus low-volatility shares highlights a persistent undercurrent of institutional caution. This hesitation finds backing in the macro landscape, where an elevated VIX at 20.03 and a strengthening dollar at $29.16 coexist alongside tightening high-yield credit spreads at 3.34% and a stable 10-year real yield of 2.63%. Ultimately, the market is caught in a tug-of-war between resilient cyclical participation and underlying volatility hedging. Expect a choppy, range-bound session with a neutral-to-cautious directional lean.
